item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00325","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C13","C12","C22"],"selected_candidate_label":"C13","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C13 is the immediately preceding postponement proclamation and supplies nearly the entire operative framework of the child: the same statutory recital, identification of the March 26, 1948 toll proclamation, description of prior postponement, public-interest finding, and formula declaring that the effective date \"is further postponed to, and shall be\" a new date. The child materially reuses this language and structure while adding recitals explaining the congressional study and proposed Panama Canal reorganization. C12 and C22 are earlier members of the same drafting lineage but are less immediate templates.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Whereas section 411 of title 2 of the Canal Zone Code...authorizes the President to prescribe and from time to time change the tolls...and provides that no tolls when so prescribed shall be changed unless six months' notice thereof is given by the President by proclamation","parent_excerpt":"Whereas section 411 of title 2 of the Canal Zone Code...authorizes the President to prescribe and from time to time change the tolls...and provides that no tolls when so prescribed shall be changed unless six months' notice thereof is given by the President by proclamation","explanation":"The statutory opening recital is reproduced essentially verbatim."},{"child_excerpt":"Whereas increased tolls for the use of the Panama Canal were prescribed by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of March 26, 1948...; and Whereas the effective date...was thereafter postponed until April 1, 1950","parent_excerpt":"Whereas increased tolls for the use of the Panama Canal were prescribed by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of March 26, 1948...; and Whereas the effective date...was thereafter postponed until September 1, 1949","explanation":"The child retains the same sequence tracing the original toll proclamation and its prior postponement, updating only the postponement history."},{"child_excerpt":"do hereby proclaim that the effective date of the said [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of march 26, 1948, is further postponed to, and shall be, April 1, 1951","parent_excerpt":"do hereby proclaim that the effective date of the said [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of March 26, 1948, is further postponed to, and shall be, April 1, 1950","explanation":"This distinctive operative sentence is copied almost exactly, with only the new effective date substituted."}]}
